description: Synthetic comments written for this project (not YouTube data) for an independent creator's hands-on review of a fictional mirrorless camera (not sponsored). Independent validation set for topic discovery and assignment: authored separately from t1-topics-v1 (different product domain, comments, taxonomy and gold), with the gold written before any provider run on it. Same schema and gold semantics as t1: gold taxonomy, one gold topic disposition per non-spam comment and the sentiment toward its primary topic; overall classification labels are oracle inputs, not a classifier benchmark. Test fixtures only.

taxonomy.name: Autofocus
taxonomy.definition: How reliably and quickly the camera finds and tracks subjects, including eye and subject detection and manual focus aids.

taxonomy.name: Image quality
taxonomy.definition: What the still images look like: detail, colour rendering, dynamic range, noise at high ISO and in-camera JPEG processing.

taxonomy.name: Video recording
taxonomy.definition: Shooting moving footage: resolutions and crops, codecs and log profiles, heat limits, rolling shutter and on-board audio.

taxonomy.name: Image stabilization
taxonomy.definition: How well in-body and digital stabilization keep handheld stills and footage steady.

taxonomy.name: Grip and handling
taxonomy.definition: How the body feels in the hand: size, weight, grip depth and where the physical dials and buttons sit.

taxonomy.name: Menus and customization
taxonomy.definition: The on-screen menu system and how far settings, custom modes and button functions can be configured.

taxonomy.name: Viewfinder and screen
taxonomy.definition: The electronic viewfinder and rear display: brightness, lag, blackout, articulation and eye-sensor behaviour.

taxonomy.name: Lens selection
taxonomy.definition: Which lenses exist for the mount, how good they are and how well adapted lenses work.

taxonomy.name: Ruggedness and sealing
taxonomy.definition: How sturdy the body is and how it copes with rain, dust, sand, cold and wear.
